div.head: Hl 14
div.ab: Gif þæt flet geblodgad wyrþe, forgylde þem mæn his mundbyrd ⁊ cyninge L scill'.
Gif þæt flet geblodgad wyrþe, forgylde þem mæn his mundbyrd ⁊ cyninge L scill'.
Gif þæt flet geblodgad wyrþe, forgylde þem mæn his mundbyrd ⁊ cyninge L sciƚƚ.
wenn das Haus blutbefleckt wird, entgelte er demselben Manne dessen Sonderschutzrecht und dem Könige 50 Schill.
if the house becomes bloodstained, let him pay that same man his special protection-right and 50 shillings to the king.
[But] if the house is stained with blood, the owner shall have his mundbyrd paid to him, and 50 shillings shall be paid to the king.
If the house is stained by bloodshed, he is to pay to the man [the price for breach of] his protection, and 50 shillings to the king.
If that house becomes bloodied, let him pay the man [the price for violation of] his protection and 50 shillings to the king.

note.label: cf. (terminology 'forgieldan')
note.quote: but in Kent 'forgieldan' was compensatory terminology. ... Ine 36. Cf. (e.g.), Abt 22-3, 26, 32, Hl 14.

note.seg: Laut der Wörter þæt (noch demonstrativ) flet, die sich auf das o. 13 erwähnte Haus beziehen, ist dies Fortsetzung von 13.
According to the words þæt (still demonstrative) flet, which refer to the house mentioned above 13, this is a continuation of 13.

Blutig (s. d. Gl 3c. 9) fechten bringt, mehr als Waffenzücken, dem Ortsherrn für voll gebrochenen Schutz volle Busse und dem König höchstes Strafgeld; Af 39, 1. Nach anderen Stellen stehen beide Friedensbrüche gleich; s. Gl ebd. 3d. 5b. c

Fighting with bloodshed (see that word in Gl 3c. 9) brings, more than drawing weapons does, full compensation to the lord of the place for fully broken protection, and the highest fine to the king; Af 39, 1. According to other passages the two breaches of the peace are on an equal footing; see Gl ibid. 3d. 5b. c
Im Königsgut 50, im Adelshof 12, im gemeinfreien Hause 6 Schill. laut Abt 8. 13ff
On the king’s estate 50, in a nobleman’s household 12, in a common freeman’s house 6 shill., according to Abt 8. 13ff
Strafe für Totschlag; Abt 6. Hinzuzudenken ist Busse an den Verwundeten, bzw. Wergeld an des Erschlagenen Sippe
Penalty for homicide; Abt 6. Compensation to the wounded man, or wergild to the slain man’s kindred, is to be understood in addition
